note: All models sourced from poly.pizza with per-model license verified on the model page (license link scraped from page HTML). No game-ripped assets. CC0 models need no attribution; CC-BY models require the strings in attributionRequired to appear somewhere public on the site (e.g. an About/Credits page).

entries.author: Quaternius
entries.notes: Smooth-shaded 4-door compact sedan with realistic proportions, small rear spoiler; reads as a modern economy sedan from aerial view.

entries.author: Quaternius
entries.notes: Smooth crossover with raked rear glass and roof rails; convincing RX-like silhouette from above.

entries.author: Muhammad Reyhan
entries.notes: Realistic crew-cab pickup (4 doors + bed) modeled on a real truck; dark body with silver lower cladding and hood scoop. Alternate rejected: Toyota Hilux 97 by same author (single cab, https://poly.pizza/m/8-0nFArehjd, CC BY 3.0) - crew cab reads more modern.

entries.author: Muhammad Reyhan
entries.notes: Realistic boxy body-on-frame SUV (Nissan Terrano) in plain blue, no markings - good blank canvas for a police re-livery. Police-specific alternates on poly.pizza were sedans or too cartoony (Quaternius Police Car /m/BwwnUrWGmV is a decent CC0 sedan cruiser if ever needed).

entries.author: Nick Ladd
entries.notes: Very realistic modern low-floor transit bus (Nova Bus LFS style). Carries an STM (Montreal transit) chevron livery baked into the model - consider recoloring/retexturing to a neutral or CapMetro-ish livery before shipping.

entries.author: Mobolaji
entries.notes: Clean angular stainless-look Cybertruck silhouette with tonneau texture. Fan-made original mesh (not game-ripped). Largest file of the set at ~1.0 MB.
